python3 << 'EOF'
import math

# Values in billions of dollars
fy_1981 = 82.590  # billion dollars
fy_1980 = 64.564  # billion dollars

lambda_val = 0.75

# Box-Cox transformation: (x^lambda - 1) / lambda
def box_cox(x, lam):
    return (x ** lam - 1) / lam

bc_1981 = box_cox(fy_1981, lambda_val)
bc_1980 = box_cox(fy_1980, lambda_val)

print(f"FY 1981 Box-Cox: {bc_1981}")
print(f"FY 1980 Box-Cox: {bc_1980}")

difference = bc_1981 - bc_1980
print(f"Difference: {difference}")

# Round to 4 decimal places
print(f"Rounded to 4 decimal places: {round(difference, 4)}")
EOF
